observer_cost_and_acceptance_limits: Read/sort, JSON serialization, UTF-8 counting and DOM assignment allocate and cost CPU; feed publication can perturb subsequent callbacks.

The feed runs after the stored callback-end measurement. Its current cost is excluded from that callback and appears only in a later envelope as previous_completed_publication_ms; max_completed_publication_ms is lifetime maximum, not a1500ms maximum.
published_at_ms is taken before serialization/DOM assignment, not GPU completion or display time.
Freshness/session/time-origin, retained coverage, paired samples and advancing sequence must be checked. Stale/incomplete/absent data is insufficient evidence of smooth playback.
Enabled and default runs must be assessed separately; no zero-overhead, CPU-isolation, scanout, GC-frequency, no-leak or universal-release claim.
